tuition.quote: Total Fees 2025 Summer or 2025-26 Fall-Winter Session $63,570.00 $2,040.90 $792.00 $66,402.90
tuition.notes: Table 1A 'Program Fee - Full-Time International Students enrolled in 4.0 credits or more in the Fall-Winter Session', Faculty of Arts & Science (University College schedule; the same FAS rate applies across colleges). Columns: program fee 63,570; incidental/ancillary 2,040.90; UHIP 792; total 66,402.90. Applies to the first-year 'Computer Science' admission stream; from year 2 the CS Major/Specialist deregulated fee (Table 3A) applies. Linked from future.utoronto.ca/finances/fees ('Find the current tuition fee schedules'); only 2025-26 schedules are published, 2026-27/2027-28 not yet.

scholarship_exists.quote: The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is the university's most prestigious award for international students.
scholarship_exists.notes: Covers 'tuition, books, incidental fees, and full residence support for four years'; about 37 scholars annually; requires nomination by the high school (nomination deadline October 9, 2026) and applying to U of T for September 2027. Note from https://future.utoronto.ca/finances/fees: 'The University of Toronto is a publicly-funded institution and cannot offer financial aid to international students' (need-based aid), but admission scholarships exist.

scholarship_international.quote: To be eligible to apply to the Pearson International Scholarship, you must be: an international student (i.e. a non-Canadian requiring a study permit);
scholarship_international.notes: Also: final year of secondary school in 2026/2027 or graduated no earlier than June 2026, and beginning studies in September 2027. Highly competitive; school nomination required.
